text:
mira: Heads-up — saw a perf regression in mixed-precision hotpath when the continuous-batcher coalesces many short sequences and pad ratio is high. attaching quick profiler output.

devin: can you drop the flame numbers here?

mira: sure, pasted sample from local run:```
cont-batcher_select 34.1%
matmul_fp8_packed 27.8%
pad_memcpy 12.4%
kv_lookup_and_requant 10.3%
fallback_matmul_int8 5.0%
other 10.4%
```

anya: interesting. so fp8-packed is high but pad_memcpy is nontrivial — sounds like we’re falling back to a padding copy path before the packed kernel.

jin: also curious if calibration introduced extra quantize/dequant ops on the hot path. we changed per-tensor scaling in the last calib PR, right?

mira: right — FP8 calibration added a fast-path that computes scale+zero_point per shard and we ended up invoking a small re-quant on prefix align because the kernel selector rejected the packed kernel for odd shapes.

devin: can you share the command to repro? I’ll run CI bench.

mira: `./tools/bench --model=redwood-small --mode=continuous --pad_ratio=0.68 --quant=fp8_calib --iters=2000`

mira: results: baseline (no calib) throughput 1487 tok/s, with calib 1385 tok/s (~7% drop), p95 latency +12%.

anya: that pad_ratio is key. selector heuristics currently prefer the packed kernel only when seq_len % 16 == 0 and pad_ratio < 0.2. we should relax that.

jin: also noticed kvcache slices: when cached KV blocks aren’t 8-byte aligned for fp8 packing we do element-wise re-quant which hits `kv_lookup_and_requant` a lot.

devin: proposed fixes: 1) adjust kernel selector to consider pad_ratio and average_seq_len rather than strict modulus; 2) add a small microkernel handling odd shapes (low-overhead pack); 3) store quant params in KV header to avoid re-calib per lookup.

mira: created PR #987 with selector heuristics and a microkernel prototype. included perf numbers in the PR description.

devin: ran the microbench from the PR: microkernel + selector tweak -> throughput 1460 tok/s, p95 down 6% vs calib-hotpath. still ~1.8% shy of baseline. promising.

anya: we should also add runtime telemetry: counter tags for `kernel_choice`, `pad_ratio_bucket`, `kv_unaligned_count`. helps correlate in console.

jin: I'll add unit + integration tests to cover odd-shaped batches and kvcache alignment cases. will mock `kv_unaligned_count` path.

mira: sample telemetry line we saw locally: `kernel_choice=packed_fp8 pad_ratio=0.68 kv_unaligned=23 model=redwood-small region=us-west2`

devin: let's canary this fix. @ops-bot can you schedule a small canary for the fix branch to us-west2-low-flock?

ops-bot: Canary job created: canary-id=canary-20240425-1530, target=us-west2, group=small-fleet, rollout=10% -> 50% over 30m.

mira: thanks — will monitor `kernel_choice` / `kv_unaligned` gauges during canary. please flag regressions. :thumbsup:

anya: one more note — we should double-check quant calibration path for FP8->INT4 fallback; there might be an extra branch in the selector when mixed-precision is enabled that prefers int8 kernels for certain shapes; that could explain fallback_matmul_int8 at ~5%.

devin: good call. I'll add a selector unit test matrix covering (seq_len, pad_ratio, quant_mode) and assert stable kernel choices.

mira: thanks everyone. I'll post the perf dashboard link in this thread once canary starts.
